ruleKinds.immune_while: Takes no damage while a condition holds (adds alive, drawn past its tether, attacker position).
ruleKinds.damage_reduced: Damage it takes is scaled down or redirected.
ruleKinds.reflect: Hits back at whoever damages it (damage shield, punishing spell on the attacker).
ruleKinds.adds: Spawns adds: when, how many, which class and brain.
ruleKinds.phase: Does something new at a health threshold.
ruleKinds.reset: Resets (walks home at full health, adds cleared) when nobody is on its aggro list.
ruleKinds.teleport: Moves someone: air toss, jail, throw to a fixed spot, or teleports itself.
ruleKinds.position_puzzle: Needs raiders in particular places (split, stand-in/stand-out), or a scripted placement puzzle.
ruleKinds.empowered: Gets stronger (a stat raised) while a condition holds: the period's 'enrage'.
ruleKinds.enrage_timer: Gets stronger after a fixed fight time.
ruleKinds.pet_devour: Eats or kills pets near it and heals.
ruleKinds.aggro_wipe: Clears its aggro list in the fight (the tank loses it).
ruleKinds.linked_pack: Pulls other monsters into the fight with it (bring-a-friend by package or brain).
ruleKinds.hazard: An untargetable, immobile or invulnerable piece of the room that hurts raiders.
ruleKinds.attacker_filter: Only some attackers can damage it at all.
ruleKinds.offline_change: The original mechanic was edited for offline bot raids (a comment in the script says so); no switch brings it back.

priority.title: Scurceol Hyrde (Krondon): immune while his four orbs live
priority.evidence: docs/NIGHT-SIEGES-AND-MARFACH.md §1b: build 8d7baa3, 2026-11-05 14:27-15:40. 59-77 of 101 raiders fought him 3,219 units from his spawn; he stayed at 100%; all 42 raider deaths were to him; he was skipped every 20 minutes and switched back to; the Beran muster stalled at 2-5 of 50. 'Lyft' is in no log line. 2026-11-06 (168f55d): the tactic fired at 01:49 and 02:16, but every orb failed the ground-route gate and was set aside; the raid went to Fuladl.

priority.plan: Fight him in his own room, not 3,000 units out where the raid met him: one tank party holds him near his spawn while four ranged parties take one orb each from the floor below it (the route already shoots flyers from below), then everyone on him. Orb kills survive his resets.

encounters.notes: Level 75, 40,000 health, 30/40% resists, tether 1,500 (immune past it). What stops damage: only the tether; his permanent Damage Shield (Heat, 100 per hit back on melee attackers, recast whenever it is not on him) does not reduce damage taken, so he is killable by design; no damage type bypasses anything and no dispel is needed (he recasts it at once). What kills raids: his four illusions (5,000 health each, spawned at fixed spots the first time he is attacked) each cast a 300 area hit in 350 around their target every brain turn, and he casts Aidon's Fire (500 Heat, radius 350) every 10-15 s. A new set of illusions comes 30-45 s after all four are dead, never while one lives. No player-only mechanic is needed to beat him, so no switch has to flip.
encounters.currentRaidAi: 2026-11-05 (build 168f55d): at 22:21 about 40 raiders fell in ten seconds to the illusions' stacked area hits while clearing trash near him; at 22:38 the raid switched to him ("it is fighting the raid") without a muster; 31 raiders fought him, all fell, he never went below 99%, and that counted as the raid's first wipe with 56 living. The next muster was placed on the ramp his chase had reached (30927,35039,15365, 2,600 from his home) and gathered 0-2 of 75 in six minutes while the fallen walked back from Camelot Hills.

aiTactics.summary: Required adds, keep one: once the fight is on the raid kills three of his four illusions (each party takes one) and leaves the last alive, because he summons a new set only when all four are dead; then everyone fights him. Fight at home: past 1,100 from his spawn (tether 1,500) the raid stops hitting him and leads him back.

Every 10% from 90% down to 10% he spawns a wave of about 12-18 'essence of fallen' (level 60-62, 2,500 health, aggro 1,500) at his feet: nine waves, roughly 110-160 adds in one fight.
